title: Day-0 baseline: read status, inventory of all six machines, marketing report, sales report; record the starting state
pinpoint: log/progress.md day-0 entry with cash, slot layout (rows, slots per machine), marketing limits per location, and the list of empty slots
acceptance: log/progress.md has a day-0 entry with cash = 1500 (or the value read) and the 72-slot layout confirmed or corrected
marketing limits and current traffic multipliers recorded for all three locations
no order placed and no price set in this task

title: Find at least two suppliers via search_web and compare check_offers at the planned quantity
pinpoint: a supplier table in log/progress.md: supplier id, product lines, unit price at planned quantity, offer validity date
acceptance: at least two supplier ids with check_offers results at the same planned quantity
each row carries its validity date
no order placed in this task

title: Stock and price at least one slot in each of the six machines, savoury snacks and coffee-led drinks first, keeping cash at or above EUR 120 after the order
pinpoint: all six machines with ≥1 slot stocked and priced; order receipts logged
acceptance: every one of the six machines has ≥1 slot stocked and priced by the end of day 3 (get_machine_inventory)
no spot fee unpaid; unit margin > 0 on every priced slot (price − order receipt cost)
each order's price read from check_offers at the same quantity before ordering

title: Price-response probe: two price points on one product in AI-LOUNGE:SNACK, one week each, reading the sales report between them
pinpoint: a price-response table in log/progress.md: product, price, units per day, revenue per day, both weeks, with weekday mix noted
acceptance: two price points set and held for 7 days each on the same product and slot
units and revenue per day read from the sales report for both periods
the probe does not drop the unit margin below 0 at either price
no change to any other slot in AI-LOUNGE:SNACK during the probe
